command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED='d7c792ff0a591011fa64c86e2f37bb85a111687f'; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; for p in "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/emulator/emulator" "$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator/emulator" "/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/emulator/emulator"; do if [ -x "$p" ]; then echo "EMULATOR=$p"; "$p" -version | head -3; echo AVDS; "$p" -list-avds; fi; done; echo AVD_DIR; ls -la "$HOME/.android/avd" 2>/dev/null || true; echo SDK_DIRS; find "$HOME/Library/Android" "$HOME/.android" -maxdepth 4 -type f -name emulator -print 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true; echo DEVICES; adb devices -l
